an5.29:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these five benefits of walking meditation.
an5.29:1.3: One becomes capable of journeys; one becomes capable of striving; one becomes healthy; what one has eaten, drunk, consumed, and tasted is properly digested; the concentration attained through walking meditation is long lasting.
an5.29:1.4: These are the five benefits of walking meditation.”
